review.summary: The recorded delivery evidence is internally consistent, but phase 31 skips retained registry archive verification. This regression in the completion gate requires correction before acceptance.

findings.description: The governance-successor branch verifies the package proofs but bypasses verify_retained_registry(), which now runs only for phases 24 and 28. Consequently, phase 31 can complete with missing or corrupted retained registry evidence. In a read-only reproduction, replacing only the registry receipt's retainedArchive value in memory with a nonexistent path still returned passed=true; verify_retained_registry was never called. The actual retained archive independently verified successfully, so this is a gate regression rather than evidence of incorrect publication.
findings.required_fix: Run verify_retained_registry for phase 31 after verifying its published-source package proofs. Add a regression exercising the complete phase-31 verify path that rejects missing, corrupted and improperly located registry archives.

evidence: Read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/PHASES.md, docs/portkey-mcp-tags-plan.md and the phase-31 status entry.
Inspected every scoped source, test and receipt artifact, including publication/readiness guards and newest-status CI selection.

Recomputed source fingerprint b9f08c9ee2541474d4d43d960972c822931d7e25c5352ab4e273c56faf63d5fa. Verified docs/checks/phase-31.json contains the required 113 commands, all recorded successful without timeouts.
Executed the offline delivery verifier successfully: published commit 4adbe971bce30b129bbd9a1a858540f4bca6c22b, CI commit bcbab09acb983838068cf987f8cf4ad93e423b3f, 49 successful contexts.
Verified both retained clean-package proofs through the delivery verifier; inspected their 18 successful command records per compiler and matching 145-file inventories.

Independently verified the retained registry archive and registry receipt's package-proof and publication-verifier hashes. Inspected matching canonical/GitHub annotated-tag receipts and run-37 evidence.
Executed seven read-only delivery validation tests successfully and reproduced the missing-registry-archive bypass using an in-memory receipt substitution.
Executed the offline site-binding check successfully for site commit cce6cb2c5cc3346aa60e4a89f5f1dcacb01bf720.
limitations: No network requests, credential access, tenant contact or checkout changes were performed. Remote publication, tags and CI were assessed through retained observations.
The full Rust, package, Python and Docusaurus build suites were not rerun; their recorded results were inspected. Only the specified read-only verifications and seven tests were executed.
Windows compilation remains unverified as documented. This chunk review does not establish complete-phase acceptance.
